name: setFlagStars
description: Shows or hides all stars in the sky. The change is animated via a fader and saved to settings.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: true to show stars, false to hide them

name: getFlagStars
description: Returns whether stars are currently displayed.
returnDescription: true if stars are visible, false if hidden
example:
var visible = StarMgr.getFlagStars();
core.debug("Stars visible: " + visible);

name: setFlagLabels
description: Shows or hides star labels (names). Saved to settings.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: true to show star labels, false to hide them

name: getFlagLabels
description: Returns whether star labels are currently displayed.
returnDescription: true if star labels are visible, false if hidden
example:
var visible = StarMgr.getFlagLabels();
core.debug("Star labels visible: " + visible);

name: setLabelsAmount
description: Sets the amount of star labels displayed. Higher values show labels for fainter stars. The real amount is also proportional to the current field of view. Saved to settings.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Labels amount between 0.0 (no labels) and 10.0 (maximum labels)

name: getLabelsAmount
description: Returns the amount of star labels. The real amount is also proportional to the current field of view.
returnDescription: Labels amount between 0.0 (no labels) and 10.0 (maximum labels)
example:
var amount = StarMgr.getLabelsAmount();
core.debug("Labels amount: " + amount);

name: setFontSize
description: Sets the font size used for star labels in pixels. Note: this is automatically updated when the application screen font size changes.

name: setFlagSciNames
description: Enables or disables showing scientific or catalog names on stars that have no common names. This is a static method: the change is NOT saved to settings and does NOT emit a signal. Default is true.

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: true to show scientific names for unnamed stars, false to hide

name: getFlagSciNames
description: Returns whether scientific or catalog names are shown on stars without common names. This is a static method (not backed by a Q_PROPERTY, so core.getStelProperty does NOT work for it).
returnDescription: true if scientific names are shown for unnamed stars, false otherwise
example:
var show = StarMgr.getFlagSciNames();
core.debug("Scientific names shown: " + show);

name: setDesignationUsage
description: Sets whether scientific catalog designations (e.g., Bayer/Flamsteed letters) are preferred over common names for star labels. Saved to settings.

parameters.name: useDesignations
parameters.description: true to prefer catalog designations, false to prefer common names

name: getDesignationUsage
description: Returns whether scientific catalog designations are preferred over common names for star labels. This is a static method (not backed by a Q_PROPERTY, so core.getStelProperty does NOT work for it).
returnDescription: true if catalog designations are preferred, false if common names are preferred
example:
var useDes = StarMgr.getDesignationUsage();
core.debug("Designation usage: " + useDes);

name: setFlagDblStarsDesignation
description: Shows or hides traditional designations (e.g., 'α1', 'α2') for double stars. Saved to settings.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: true to show double star designations, false to hide

name: getFlagDblStarsDesignation
description: Returns whether double star designations are shown. This is a static method (not backed by a Q_PROPERTY, so core.getStelProperty does NOT work for it).
returnDescription: true if double star designations are shown, false otherwise
example:
var show = StarMgr.getFlagDblStarsDesignation();
core.debug("Double star designations: " + show);

name: setFlagVarStarsDesignation
description: Shows or hides variable star designations (e.g., 'R And', 'δ Cep') for star labels. Saved to settings.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: true to show variable star designations, false to hide

name: getFlagVarStarsDesignation
description: Returns whether variable star designations are shown. This is a static method (not backed by a Q_PROPERTY, so core.getStelProperty does NOT work for it).
returnDescription: true if variable star designations are shown, false otherwise
example:
var show = StarMgr.getFlagVarStarsDesignation();
core.debug("Variable star designations: " + show);

name: setFlagHIPDesignation
description: Shows or hides Hipparcos catalog numbers (e.g., 'HIP 12345') as star labels. Saved to settings.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: true to show HIP numbers, false to hide

name: getFlagHIPDesignation
description: Returns whether Hipparcos catalog numbers are shown as star labels. This is a static method (not backed by a Q_PROPERTY, so core.getStelProperty does NOT work for it).
returnDescription: true if HIP numbers are shown, false otherwise
example:
var show = StarMgr.getFlagHIPDesignation();
core.debug("HIP designations: " + show);

name: setFlagAdditionalNames
description: Shows or hides additional star names (cultural/alternative names from the current sky culture) when available. Saved to settings.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: true to show additional names, false to hide

name: getFlagAdditionalNames
description: Returns whether additional star names (cultural/alternative names) are shown. This is a static method (not backed by a Q_PROPERTY, so core.getStelProperty does NOT work for it).
returnDescription: true if additional names are shown, false otherwise
example:
var show = StarMgr.getFlagAdditionalNames();
core.debug("Additional names shown: " + show);
